mapper.update: UPDATE theme.${table} x SET plot_key = p.plot_key, community_key = p.community_key, district_key = p.district_key, municipality_code = coalesce(p.municipality_code, x.municipality_code) FROM theme.sp_plot p WHERE x.plot_key IS NULL AND x.${col} IS NOT NULL AND p.plot_key = x.${col}

UPDATE theme.${table} x SET plot_key = p.plot_key, community_key = p.community_key, district_key = p.district_key, municipality_code = p.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_plot p WHERE x.plot_key IS NULL AND x.${col} IS NOT NULL AND length(x.${col}) <= 8 AND p.cancel_date IS NULL AND p.plot_id = x.${col} AND (p.municipality_code = x.municipality_code OR (x.municipality_code IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM theme.sp_plot q WHERE q.plot_id = p.plot_id AND q.plot_key <> p.plot_key AND q.cancel_date IS NULL)))

UPDATE theme.${table} x SET plot_key = p.plot_key, community_key = p.community_key, district_key = p.district_key, municipality_code = coalesce(p.municipality_code, x.municipality_code) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (municipality_code, z, s, n) municipality_code, z, s, n, plot_key, community_key, district_key FROM (SELECT municipality_code, upper(trim(zone_tpss)) AS z, upper(trim(sector_tpss)) AS s, upper(trim(plot_number)) AS n, plot_key, community_key, district_key FROM theme.sp_plot WHERE cancel_date IS NULL AND zone_tpss IS NOT NULL AND sector_tpss IS NOT NULL AND plot_number IS NOT NULL) q ORDER BY municipality_code, z, s, n, plot_key) p WHERE x.plot_key IS NULL AND x.district_key IS NULL AND x.${zone} IS NOT NULL AND x.${sector} IS NOT NULL AND x.${plot} IS NOT NULL AND p.z = upper(trim(x.${zone})) AND p.s = upper(trim(x.${sector})) AND p.n = upper(trim(x.${plot})) AND (x.municipality_code IS NULL OR p.municipality_code = x.municipality_code)

UPDATE theme.${table} x SET plot_key = p.plot_key, community_key = p.community_key, district_key = p.district_key, municipality_code = p.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_plot p WHERE x.district_key IS NULL AND x.${geom} IS NOT NULL AND p.cancel_date IS NULL AND p.geom && x.${geom} AND ST_Intersects(p.geom, x.${geom});
UPDATE theme.${table} x SET community_key = c.community_key, district_key = c.district_key, municipality_code = c.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_community c WHERE x.district_key IS NULL AND x.${geom} IS NOT NULL AND c.geom && x.${geom} AND ST_Intersects(c.geom, x.${geom}); UPDATE theme.${table} x SET district_key = d.district_key, municipality_code = d.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_district d WHERE x.district_key IS NULL AND x.${geom} IS NOT NULL AND d.geom && x.${geom} AND ST_Intersects(d.geom, x.${geom})

UPDATE theme.dev_capital_project x SET district_key = d.district_key, municipality_code = d.municipality_code FROM theme.sp_district d WHERE x.district_key IS NULL AND x.cip_location_district IS NOT NULL AND (upper(d.name_en) = upper(trim(x.cip_location_district)) OR upper(d.popular_name_en) = upper(trim(x.cip_location_district))) AND (x.municipality_code IS NULL OR d.municipality_code = x.municipality_code)

UPDATE theme.dev_capital_project SET completed = coalesce(status, '') ~* '(complet|closed)' OR coalesce(phase, '') ~* '(complet|closed)'; UPDATE theme.dev_capital_project SET delayed = NOT completed AND (actual_forecast_com_date > original_planned_com_date OR revised_progress - actual_progress > 10)

UPDATE theme.mkt_unit_status x SET unit_key = u.unit_key, building_key = u.building_key FROM theme.sp_unit u WHERE x.tawtheeq_unit_id IS NOT NULL AND x.municipality_code IS NOT NULL AND x.plot_key IS NOT NULL AND u.unit_key = x.municipality_code || '-' || x.tawtheeq_unit_id AND u.plot_key = x.plot_key
